name: Custom GPT Pinecone Memory
description_md:
This resource allows you to use Pinecone, a powerful vector database, with ChatGPT to achieve pseudo-infinite memory using a custom action and a microservice built in Replit. This setup allows your GPT to store and retrieve contextual information seamlessly, making it smarter and more persistent over time.
You'll get a step-by-step guide on setting up Pinecone, linking it to ChatGPT, and leveraging its vector storage for enhanced memory and long-term knowledge retention. Whether you're building AI assistants, research tools, or any memory-intensive applications, this tutorial will equip you with the skills to expand your GPT’s capabilities.
